comment: Known compliance deviations accepted by policy. Accept a deviation only when exact compatibility is infeasible and the observable impact is immaterial. Entries must match exactly; tolerances must be query-specific and bounded. Any drift (different query, different diff shape, over-margin values, or unused allowlist entry) fails reconciliation so regressions surface.

tolerances.reason: ClickHouse native modulo uses x - trunc(x / y) * y instead of Go/Prometheus math.Mod, which causes tiny float drift on large operands. Accept only when the rerun against both APIs stays within a 1e-6 absolute margin and labels/timestamps still match exactly.
